title: Definitions.
bodyText:
As used in this part:

"District" means the Pulehunui community development district.

"Fund" means the Pulehunui community development district special fund.
bodyHtml:
[§206E-262]  Definitions.  As used in this part:

     "District" means the Pulehunui community development district.

     "Fund" means the Pulehunui community development district special fund. [L 2022, c 190, pt of §1]
